notes.title: Fixes for better user experience
notes.notes:
Night can no longer move during Sol's Zoom.

Language correction, when the player saved, the writing was always in English with "No Load".

Double jump is no longer spent when pressing X ("jump") when trying to make a jump from the wall.

It is possible to stand on a side platform.

"And You" in credits corrected for selected language.

Upon dying, all of Night's abilities become apt to use, if you have them.

4 seconds of waiting to be able to skip the credits. Preventing the frantic click to skip the end story skips the result of time and deaths as well.

It is no longer possible to beat Sol after the Night died.

notes.title: First day Fixes
notes.notes:
It is now possible to skip the credits after having seen them at least once.

Time of Sol's quadruple solar rays now are in sync with the sound of flames.

Correction of the writing in the initial part of the story.
